name: Systematic debugging ladder: reproduce, then run the cheapest DISCRIMINATING probe first
description: Blueprint 44 of 96 (BP-DBG-01). Reproduce, isolate and EXPLAIN a defect before any fix is proposed. Two mechanisms are bound together that neither source has on its own: reproduce-before-fix, and probe ORDERING by cost-to-discrimination ratio. A hypothesis with no discriminating probe is not admitted as a hypothesis, and the loop carries the two-strikes pivot - after the second failure on the same hypothesis it stops and enumerates at least two alternatives instead of grinding. When the defect cannot be reproduced the work is explicitly reclassified as instrumentation rather than fixed on a guess.

symptom.description: The observed behaviour, stated as an observation rather than as a diagnosis

repro_attempt.description: What has already been tried to reproduce it, so the ladder does not repeat a failed route

environment.description: The environment the symptom was observed in - shell, OS, interpreter, line endings

max_probe_budget.description: Probes are ordered by cost/discrimination; the budget bounds the ladder, not the ordering

parallel_probes_allowed.description: S3b: only when hypotheses are MUTUALLY INDEPENDENT - dependent probes contaminate each other

investigator.description: Reproduces, enumerates hypotheses with a discriminating probe each, and explains the mechanism. Proposes no fix before an explanation exists.

rival-hypothesis-generator.description: Supplies the competing explanation for every candidate root cause, plus the experiment that would discriminate between them

routes.reason: a rival explanation from the same vendor inherits the same blind spot that produced the first one

stages.title: S0 REPRODUCE deterministically - three of three, or say non-deterministic

work_unit.title: Reproduce the symptom deterministically in a disposable environment at the observed commit
work_unit.question_or_target: Reproduce the symptom at least three times in a disposable environment pinned to the observed commit and environment, and report the success ratio honestly. A 2-of-3 reproduction is reported as NON-DETERMINISTIC, not rounded up to reproduced.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: reproduction is the step every later claim rests on

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the exact command, the pinned commit sha, and the raw output of every attempt including the failures - three attempts recorded, not one attempt asserted three times
tests_required: a heisenbug must be reported as non-deterministic with its measured ratio, never as a confident reproduction
both-states control: the same command at a commit BEFORE the defect was introduced must NOT reproduce it; if it reproduces everywhere the harness is measuring something else
the environment fields actually used must be echoed back - a reproduction that ignores line_endings on this platform is not reproducing the reported case
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer who runs the recorded command in their own disposable environment and reports their own ratio
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CNF-0018 emitted only when reproduction.json exists, parses, and records at least three attempts with raw output and an honest success ratio; otherwise FAILED:CNF-0018 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed reproduction routes, enumerate at least two alternative routes (different shell, different commit, different fixture) before a third attempt

stages.title: Not reproducible is a valid outcome: the work becomes instrumentation, and that is recorded
S1 ENUMERATE hypotheses, each with a rival explanation and a discriminating probe
A hypothesis with no discriminating probe is not a hypothesis
S2 ORDER probes by cost-to-discrimination ratio - cheapest DISCRIMINATING probe first
S3 PROBE down the ordered ladder until exactly one hypothesis survives

body.title: Run the next probe on the ladder and record what it eliminated
S3b OPTIONAL - probe mutually INDEPENDENT hypotheses concurrently
One probe whose result cannot be contaminated by a sibling probe

stages.title: S4 EXPLAIN the mechanism, THEN propose the fix - never the other way round
No fix proposal may predate the explanation it claims to be based on

impact.blast_radius: read-only investigation: Edit and Write are DENIED by tool policy, so the ladder cannot change the code it is diagnosing

worked_example.scenario: Symptom: a shell script that passes `bash -n` locally fails in CI with `syntax error near unexpected token`.
worked_example.s0: reproduced 3/3 by running the script under the CI interpreter rather than the local one; the local interpreter reproduces 0/3, which is itself the first discriminating datum
worked_example.s1: hypotheses: (H1) CRLF line endings, (H2) an interpreter version difference, (H3) a missing coreutil, (H4) an environment variable. Each carries a rival explanation and a probe
worked_example.s2_ordering: H1's probe is `file` plus a byte dump - seconds, and it separates H1 from H2/H3/H4 outright. H2's probe needs a matrix build - minutes. H1 goes first on cost-to-discrimination, not on how plausible it feels
worked_example.s3: the byte dump shows CRLF; H1 survives, H2-H4 are eliminated by one cheap probe. probes_run = 1 against a budget of 12
worked_example.two_strikes_case: on a sibling bug, the first hypothesis failed twice. no_progress_rounds=2 fires, the loop stops, and two alternative approaches are enumerated before any third attempt - the anti-grind control
worked_example.non_deterministic_case: a heisenbug reproducing 1/3 exits through not-reproducible-becomes-instrumentation with emit-partial: the deliverable is instrumentation, and no root cause is claimed

x_extensions.distinctive_mechanism: probe ORDERING by cost-to-discrimination is a first-class stage that gates the loop, and Edit/Write are denied so no fix can be applied before the explanation exists
contraindications: NOT when the fix is obvious AND cheap to revert - the ladder costs more than the fix
NOT when the symptom is 'nothing happened' - validate the INSTRUMENT first with the both-states control blueprint
NOT for a defect already reproduced and explained - start at the fix
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: the both-states blueprint validates the INSTRUMENT; this finds the defect once the instrument is trusted, and its defining artifact is an ordered probe ladder rather than a fixture pair.
